Overview

IDSA is a medical association representing physicians, scientists and other healthcare professionals who specialise in infectious diseases. Its website is a large, content-heavy resource for members and the public. Working on the newtarget team, I took part in moving the site from Drupal to WordPress and in designing the content structure it now runs on.

The challenge

Migrating a large, established site between CMSs is never a straight copy. Drupal and WordPress model content differently, so structured content has to be re-mapped rather than pasted; editors need a system they can manage without breaking layouts; and 100+ pages have to arrive intact. The new architecture had to make the site easier to maintain, not just different.

Approach

  1. Model the content first

    Defined an ACF-based content architecture — structured fields and reusable layouts instead of free-form pages — so content is consistent across the site and editors work with clear inputs.

  2. Build the templates on that model

    Implemented custom WordPress templates that render the structured content, keeping presentation and data separate.

  3. Migrate and verify

    Moved 100+ pages from Drupal into the new structure and checked them against the source.

  4. Ship through the pipeline

    Supported deployment through newtarget's DevOps setup — CI/CD pipelines, deployments and security updates.

What I delivered

  • Drupal → WordPress migration
  • ACF content architecture
  • 100+ pages migrated into structured content
  • Custom WordPress templates
  • Deployment and DevOps support
